Part of [H: Systemic hormonal preparations, excluding sex hormones and insulins](../).

**Mechanistic extrapolation.**
QSP is the characteristic modality here: multiscale calcium homeostasis and bone remodeling models predict bone mineral density, and FDA used one reviewing rhPTH(1-84) dosing in hypoparathyroidism [@petersonFDAAdvisoryMeeting2015; @riggsPharmacometricsSystemsPharmacology2019].
